notes.title: Aster Update 1.1: Braking and More turning options
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We have been paying attention closely to the recent reception regarding Aster's controls.

In order to improve this experience we have made braking function!

You can now force the heroine's ship to come to a complete stop with b and y (space and shift on keyboard). You can also use the bumpers on gamepads to turn as well for those who may feel that is a better option. This should hopefully improve your experience with the game. 

We will be monitoring your feedback closely. Thanks you so much for your patience.

notes.title: Aster to release in 24 hours!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Me and K have been rushing in the background to try to get this game released somewhere inside of the next 24 hours.

Please be patient while we add in the last bit of polish and make sure that the translations are good to go.

Aster is a short and sweet title... thus we will be pricing it here steam for only 2.99$ . 

The game can be considered "hard" to some people... but if you guys follow this creators work, you should know what your in for! Have fun!
